title: bug: JetBrains Done-column Clear (✕) archives every DONE task in scope while a board search is active, but its confirmation counts only the matching cards
description:
Files: moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/MoeToolWindowPanel.kt (the Done column's onClearColumn block), plus a new pure helper and a JUnit 4 test under moe-jetbrains/src/{main,test}/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/ (BoardApproval.kt and BoardApprovalTest.kt are the precedent). No open row declares any moe-jetbrains file. I checked the plan files of every non-DONE row at 2026-11-02 20:51Z.

Defect, read at HEAD 3e092cff:
- MoeToolWindowPanel builds `tasks` from the epic filter plus the search query (:488-500). Each column's `columnTasks` comes from `tasks` (:717).
- The Done column's onClearColumn (:654-666) asks "Archive {0} completed task(s)?" (MoeBundle moe.message.archiveDone) using `columnTasks.size`, which is the search-filtered count. It then calls service.archiveDoneTasks(selectedEpicId).
- That sends ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS with only the epic id (MoeCommandSender.kt:196-203). The daemon handler (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:907-926) archives every DONE task in that epic, or on the whole board when All epics is selected.
- Example: 25 DONE tasks, and a search that shows 2. The dialog says 2, and the click archives 25.
- The damage can't be undone to DONE. JetBrains has no un-archive UI, and set_task_status allows ARCHIVED to go only to BACKLOG or WORKING (setTaskStatus.ts:53), so the rows can never return to DONE.

Reach: any JetBrains user who searches the board and then clicks the Done column's ✕ (TaskColumn.kt:131).

Origin: hunt requested by governor-e6b40560 (msg-5fe3b1537cb04b50964bd0edf07db4c8). Feature rows 7e77f244 (clear DONE column) and 12d97434 (board search) never covered their interaction.

Fix direction: JetBrains only, no daemon protocol change. Either don't offer ✕ while a search is active, or make the confirmation's count the number of DONE tasks the daemon will actually archive, ignoring the search. Choose at planning.
definitionOfDone: With a non-blank search query, the Done column never asks to confirm a count that differs from what ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS will archive. Either ✕ is not offered while a search is active, or the dialog's count is the number of DONE tasks in the selected epic (every epic when none is selected), ignoring the search. With no search, ✕ and its count behave exactly as before.

The rule lives in a small pure function (no Swing, no Project) that MoeToolWindowPanel calls. A new JUnit 4 test covers four cases: no search; a search matching a subset with an epic selected; a search matching a subset with All epics; and an empty Done column, which offers no ✕. RED first: the subset cases fail before the fix, and the completion evidence quotes the failing output.

`cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits 0, run under the jetbrains-gradle lease (moe.acquire_resource, then release). From WSL, run `cmd.exe /c gradlew.bat test --rerun` in the task's checkout and label the evidence Windows. Its output is the complete_task evidence.
No daemon or VS Code file changes. MoeBundle.properties changes only if the dialog wording changes, and then only its archiveDone keys.

implementationPlan.description:
TESTS FIRST (RED). Create two new files with the Write tool (global rule [2]). Match BoardApproval.kt's LF line endings.

(a) moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/DoneColumnClear.kt: `object DoneColumnClear { fun archiveCount(allTasks: List<Task>, selectedEpicId: String?, visibleDone: List<Task>): Int? }` (import com.moe.model.Task; no Swing, no Project). For now its body is TODAY's shipped rule, so the RED run measures shipped behavior: `visibleDone.size.takeIf { it > 0 }`. That is the panel's `columnTasks.size`, plus TaskColumn's empty-column hiding. Step 2 replaces the body.

(b) moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/DoneColumnClearTest.kt: JUnit 4, shaped like BoardApprovalTest. A task(id, epicId, status) helper fills Task's required fields (id, epicId, title, description, status, order, definitionOfDone, implementationPlan, prLink, reopenReason, assignedWorkerId).
Fixture:
- epic-1: d1, d2, d3 DONE, plus one each of WORKING, AWAITING_APPROVAL and BLOCKED;
- epic-2: d4, d5 DONE, plus one REVIEW and one ARCHIVED.
Only status DONE counts, exactly as the daemon's ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS does.
Tests:
1. `no search quotes the visible Done column`: visible = every DONE task in scope gives 3 for epic-1 and 5 for null (All epics).
2. `a search subset with an epic selected quotes every DONE task in that epic`: epic-1 with visible [d2] gives 3.
3. `a search subset with All epics quotes every DONE task on the board`: null with visible [d1, d4] gives 5.
4. `an empty Done column offers no clear`: visible [] gives null, for epic-1 and for null, although the search hides DONE tasks.
5. A source guard (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-dialog-order-untestable). Read src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/MoeToolWindowPanel.kt, trying File(relative) and then File("moe-jetbrains/$relative"); throw IllegalStateException when neither is a file. Slice it with substringAfter("onClearColumn = if (isDone)").substringBefore("onNext =") and check the slice is not blank. Assert the slice contains "DoneColumnClear.archiveCount(" and does not contain "columnTasks.size". Also assert the positive half, so deleting the dialog cannot pass: it still contains "moe.message.archiveDone" and "service.archiveDoneTasks(".

RED run (DoD 2), under the lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease):
- Call moe.acquire_resource { resourceId: "jetbrains-gradle", taskId, workerId, note: "DoneColumnClearTest RED" }. If it is queued, report_blocked with that resourceId; the grant unblocks the row.
- From the worktree in WSL bash (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-from-wsl):
W=$(wslpath -w "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)") && cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d $W\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --tests com.moe.toolwindow.DoneColumnClearTest --rerun"
- Release the lease right after, whatever the result.
Expected: exit 1. Tests 2, 3 and 5 fail (expected:<3> but was:<1>, expected:<5> but was:<2>, and the guard); 1 and 4 pass. Any other split means a test is wrong. Save the failure lines for the complete_task summary.
error handling: 'Could not receive a message from the daemon' is the gradlew client OOM (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-client-oom), not a test result. Re-run it.

FIX. Edit two files with the Edit tool.

(a) DoneColumnClear.kt. Replace the body with: `if (visibleDone.isEmpty()) return null; return allTasks.count { it.status == "DONE" && (selectedEpicId.isNullOrEmpty() || it.epicId == selectedEpicId) }`. The doc comment says why:
- ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts: `t.status === 'DONE' && (!epicFilter || t.epicId === epicFilter)`) archives every DONE task in the epic, or on the whole board, and never sees the board search.
- So the confirmation counts from the full task list, not from the search-filtered column.
- An empty visible column offers no ✕ (TaskColumn.kt hides it too).

(b) MoeToolWindowPanel.kt: the Done column's onClearColumn block only (about :654-666).
- Read selectedEpicId once into a local `epicId`, and use it for both the count and service.archiveDoneTasks(epicId).
- Compute the count at CLICK time: `DoneColumnClear.archiveCount(lastState?.tasks ?: allTasks, epicId, columnTasks)`. updateColumn skips rebuilding the Done column while its own cards' fingerprint is unchanged, so a count captured at render time goes stale when a task the search hides reaches DONE.
- Show no dialog when the count is null.
- Keep the message keys (moe.message.archiveDone, archiveDoneTitle) and their arguments.

DoD 4: no MoeBundle.properties, daemon or VS Code change. With no search the count equals the visible column, exactly as before. Re-run step 1's focused command under the lease, then release it. All 5 tests pass.

VERIFY: run the DoD 3 gate once, under the jetbrains-gradle lease: acquire, run, then release whatever the result. In worktree mode it runs in this task's worktree, never the control checkout. From WSL bash:
W=$(wslpath -w "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)") && cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d $W\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"

A PowerShell seat runs the same gate from <W>\moe-jetbrains with $env:GRADLE_OPTS='-Xmx512m' and .\gradlew.bat test --rerun (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-gate-from-powershell). Report the spelling you actually ran, labeled Windows (DoD 3).

Expected: exit 0. Confirm that tests really ran:
grep -h -o 'tests="[0-9]*" skipped="[0-9]*" failures="[0-9]*" errors="[0-9]*"' moe-jetbrains/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml | awk -F'"' '{t+=$2; s+=$4; f+=$6; e+=$8} END {print t, s, f, e}'
Expect failures 0 and errors 0, and TEST-com.moe.toolwindow.DoneColumnClearTest.xml with 5 tests (mem:gotcha-gradle-jetbrains-shared-box). DoD 4: git status --porcelain lists only the 3 files outside .moe/.

Submit complete_task verification as { command: the exact line you ran, exitCode: 0, outputTail: the BUILD SUCCESSFUL tail plus the XML sums }, together with the step-1 RED quote.

error handling:
- A red exit with no failing test XML is usually the Gradle IPC flake. Check the daemon log (mem:gotcha-gradle-jetbrains-shared-box), then re-run.
- A failure in a test class this task did not touch: tie it to a peer with `git log -- <file>`, disclose it, and never edit the peer's file.

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW, the final step. Load the adversarial-self-review skill and read your diff of the 3 files as an attacker. Check:
- The count equals what the daemon archives in every scope: an epic, All epics (null), and a blank epicId (the daemon's `!epicFilter`).
- Only DONE counts. AWAITING_APPROVAL, BLOCKED, REVIEW and ARCHIVED never do.
- With no search, the count and ✕ visibility are exactly as before.
- The count is computed at click time, and the archive sends the same local epicId the count used.
- A null count shows no dialog.
- The guard test throws when the source file is missing and asserts the positive half.
- Message keys and arguments are unchanged. No MoeBundle, daemon or VS Code file changed.
- The forbidden-pattern rails.

Fix what you find. Re-run step 3's command under the lease if any code changed, then call complete_task.

reopenReason: Human "move from backlog"; architect hunt row: JetBrains Done-column clear archives all DONE tasks while a search filters the count (irreversible).

executionContract.intendedBehavior: The JetBrains Done column's Clear (✕) confirmation quotes exactly the number of tasks ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS will archive: every DONE task in the selected epic, or on the whole board for All epics, ignoring the board search, which only hides cards. Without a search, nothing changes. An empty visible Done column still offers no ✕.
acceptanceCriteria: DoneColumnClearTest has 5 JUnit 4 tests: no search; a search subset with an epic selected; a search subset with All epics; an empty Done column (null); and a source guard that MoeToolWindowPanel's Done onClearColumn calls DoneColumnClear.archiveCount and no longer uses columnTasks.size.
RED: against the shipped rule (visibleDone.size), tests 2, 3 and 5 fail and the completion summary quotes them.
The full `gradlew.bat test --rerun` in the task worktree exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 errors in TEST-*.xml, labeled Windows.
invariants: The ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS payload (epicId only), MoeCommandSender, TaskColumn, the daemon and VS Code are unchanged.
The MoeBundle archiveDone keys and their arguments are unchanged.
Gradle runs only under the jetbrains-gradle lease, released after each run.
compatibility: No wire or state change. The confirmation's count changes only while a search hides some DONE cards.
approvedScope: New object com.moe.toolwindow.DoneColumnClear with fun archiveCount(allTasks: List<Task>, selectedEpicId: String?, visibleDone: List<Task>): Int?
MoeToolWindowPanel.kt: only the Done column's onClearColumn lambda.
reuse: BoardApproval.kt and BoardApprovalTest.kt are the pure-helper and headless-test precedent; the source-guard shape comes from mem:gotcha-jetbrains-dialog-order-untestable.
sourceAssumptions: MoeToolWindowPanel.kt builds `tasks` from epic filter + searchQuery (about :488-500); updateColumn's columnTasks comes from it (about :717); the Done onClearColumn quotes columnTasks.size and calls service.archiveDoneTasks(selectedEpicId) (about :654-666); `lastState` (about :58) holds the newest MoeState.
TaskColumn.kt:131 shows ✕ only when onClearColumn != null && tasks.isNotEmpty().
MoeCommandSender.archiveDoneTasks (about :196-203) sends epicId only when non-null.
checkRefs: W=$(wslpath -w "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)") && cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d $W\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Option A, hiding ✕ while a search is active, was rejected. It removes a working feature during search, and it makes the DoD's epic and All-epics subset cases indistinguishable. Option B, chosen: keep ✕ and quote the true archive count (DONE in scope, ignoring the search). It needs no wording change, so MoeBundle stays untouched (DoD 4). A new 'the search hides N' message was also rejected: it is extra bundle keys for a count the dialog already states honestly. Passing the search query into the helper was rejected too, because it would duplicate the panel's title/description match.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- The Done column shows displayStatus == DONE, i.e. status DONE exactly (AWAITING_APPROVAL maps to Planning, BLOCKED to Working, and ARCHIVED is never shown), so without a search the visible count equals the daemon's count.
- The column is rebuilt only when its own fingerprint changes, so the onClearColumn lambda can hold a stale render-time capture; compute the count at click time from lastState.
- VS Code's moe.archiveDoneTasks asks for the epic via QuickPick and shows no count, so the bug is JetBrains-only.
- Worker worktrees are D:\projexts\moes\.worktrees\<taskId>, sparse /* !/.moe/ (all of moe-jetbrains present), so cmd.exe gradle runs there.
- Kotlin files now use LF (BoardApproval.kt, MoeToolWindowPanel.kt).
planningNotes.risks:
- The client state can lag the daemon, which the dialog cannot fix. Click time is the freshest point the panel has.
- The first gradle run in a fresh worktree compiles from scratch (slower). Hold the lease only around each run.
- `arrayOf(stringValue, intValue)` is a compile error here; write arrayOf<Any>(...) (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gate-snapshot).
- The source guard depends on the literal 'onClearColumn = if (isDone)' and 'onNext =' anchors. Keep them, or update the guard in the same diff.
